note: the light's y sign is flipped, so a bevel lit from 90 degrees lights the top edge instead of the bottom, caught by BevelTests.lightFromBelowAtNinety
the bevel ignores up, so a sunk edge is lit like a raised one, caught by BevelTests.downSwapsTheLight
the bevel height is not clamped at size, so the top keeps sloping past it and lights the middle, caught by BevelTests.flatPastSize
bevel opacity ignored, so a half-opacity highlight or shadow draws at full, caught by StyleCompositeCoverageTests.bevelOpacityScalesTheLight
anchor: let k = cover * opacity, o = i * c
replacement: let k = cover, o = i * c

note: emboss clipped to the alpha like an inner bevel, so emboss and pillow light nothing outside the edge, caught by StyleCompositeCoverageTests.embossLightsBothSidesOfTheEdge
emboss rise starts at the edge, so an emboss rises like an inner bevel, caught by StyleCompositeCoverageTests.riseAndProfilePerShapeAndTechnique
pillow emboss rise at half rate, so a pillow reaches its top at twice the size, caught by StyleCompositeCoverageTests.riseAndProfilePerShapeAndTechnique
smooth profile is a straight ramp, so a smooth bevel lights like a chisel, caught by StyleCompositeCoverageTests.riseAndProfilePerShapeAndTechnique
